name: Uchuu Keiji Soldivan
original_name: 宇宙刑事ソルディバン
source:
One day, a group of UFO suddenly appear and they order people to join the Galaxy Union. After some twists and turns, they decide to join it. This is a story about the space police, fighting against criminals who ran away from other planets....
